mechanism: Both drugs lower seizure threshold and can cause CNS effects; mefloquine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of clobazam's active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, increasing seizure risk in patients with epilepsy.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider alternative antimalarial or adjust clobazam dosing; assess for increased CNS adverse effects and neuropsychiatric symptoms.
